note: Crowd reactions copied from the Courtside project (assets/audio/crowd). Cuts of the recordings listed below.

crowd_gasp_1.use: Quick gasp: dives, net cords, close calls

crowd_ooh_1.use: Unison ooh: long rallies, great gets

crowd_aah_1.use: Unison aah: admiring a long rally or a touch winner

crowd_cheer.use: Short affirmative cheer: winners and aces

crowd_cheer_big.use: Cheering and whistling: games, sets, the match

crowd_applause_loud.use: Loud applause: games and big points

crowd_ovation.use: Applause, cheering and whistling: the match

crowd_inhale.use: Group inhale: a smash is coming

crowd_laugh_1.use: Audience laugh: airballs and backboard-only bricks

crowd_laugh_2.use: Audience laugh, layered take: airballs and backboard-only bricks
